mission_01: Excellent work! You have successfully implemented the core components of an ARIMA forecasting model from scratch. By simulating ARIMA data, you gained intuition about how autoregressive and moving average components shape time series behavior. The stationarity test using the Augmented Dickey-Fuller approach gave you a statistical tool to determine whether differencing is needed. Finally, solving the Yule-Walker equations to estimate AR parameters and generate recursive forecasts demonstrates the mathematical elegance behind one of the most widely used forecasting methods in economics, finance, and operations research. This foundation will serve you well as you explore more sophisticated models in subsequent missions.
